en: I see... That's pretty deep.

There's no need to
overthink it. Memorize it
with your body, not your
head.
Right, right! Nothing beats\nhands-on experience.\nThank you, Amina.
It's my pleasure. Good\nluck!
Huh? What are you doing\nthere, Lymle?
What are YOU doing,\nFaize?
Oh, me? Amina's teaching\nme how to use a bow and\narrow.

It's a cool weapon. You
can feel it sharpening your
senses the more you
practice.

Hey, Reimi was using a
bow too, right? I should
ask her about it when I
see her!

What about you, Lymle?
It's always good to try
something new. How about
it?
... Nope, I don't care about\nbows and arrows. Not at\nall, 'kay.
How about being more\nopen-minded for a\nchange?

You're just missing out on
new experiences, you
know. It's good to expand
your palate once in a
while.

Hmph! I am open-minded! I
just really, REALLY don't
care about bores and
ow-ows, 'kay!
Wait, Lymle!
Don't worry about it,\nCaptain. She's always like\nthat.
I'm just embarrassed you\nhad to see it.

After not seeing her for
such a long time, I was
hoping to find something
we could bond over.
...Sorry, I shouldn't bore\nyou with my personal\nproblems.
I'll get back to work, now.\nSee you around.

Ah, Captain! Did you hear
the rumors and come to
see for yourself? That girl
sure is full of surprises.
Lymle! We're talking about\nLymle!
Lymle came to me asking\nhow to use a gun the\nother day.
I only taught her a little\nbit, but...well, you can see\nthe results.
Aye!
Yeargh!
There's no holding back\nagainst her now.
Isn't Lymle cute!? She\nreminds me of a cat, the\nway she acts on impulse!
I even got her to change\ninto the Federation\nAcademy uniform!
Dance, fool!
Now I'm gonna show you\nmy serious face!
Ngh...
...Slippery worm!
Ahhhhh! Lymle wins!!!
Well, that was easy, 'kay.
How did I lose to a stupid\nlittle runt...?
Hmph. Shut your mouth,\nPavi.
Urgh!

You're the real deal, short
stuff. There's no one left
who can compete with you
now.
Emmy! I may be short, but\nenough with the "stuff"!
Ah, sorry, sorry. I meant\n"little lady."

Speaking of which... Maybe
when you're a bit older, we
could go out for dinner
sometime?
Commander Kenny!
I'm kidding! Don't look at\nme that way.

Never mind all that. Lymle,
what made you want to
learn to shoot a gun all of
a sudden?
...N-no reason.
(Oh, so she's doing it to\nrebel against Faize,\nhmmm?)
What? N-no, that's not it!\n<player>, Faize has nothing\nto do with it, 'kay!
I want to be super strong,\nso I can fight for\neveryone!
But, Lymle... Why is it that\nyou don't seem to respect\nFaize?
And why were you\nwatching Faize and Amina\ntalking from a distance...?
I-I have no idea what\nyou're talking about! I'm\ngoing now! Bye!
Oops. Did I make her\nmad?
You need to stop teasing\nher!
Besides, what you were\nasking is none of your\nbusiness.

You're right. This sort of
thing is best left to the
elders among us. Right,
Captain?
Captain!!! I need your help!
Lymle's gun is out of\ncontrol! We need to do\nsomething!
How did this happen?\nWell... Ummm...
Commander Kenny\naccidentally gave her an\nunfinished gun.
I just wanted to reward\nher for practicing so\nhard...

He accidentally gave her a
prototype gun from the
Symbological Research
Facility...

L-look, this is no time to
be pointing fingers, right!?
We need to help Lymle!
Let's go!!!
Hey, wait! If you're going\nto help Lymle, could you\nplease take me with you?
Of course! I knew we\ncould count on you!
Come on, let's go!
Not good, not good...
I just can't stop it, 'kay!
Are you okay, Lymle!?\nWe'll save you!

That gun... Its damage
keeps increasing. It seems
to draw power from
something resembling a
symbological spell.

Since Lymle is herself
basically one big
symbological spell, it's
drawing too much power...
I could hit it with my own\nsymbological spell in order\nto cancel it out...
But then what will happen\nto Lymle!?
The captain's right, Faize!\nYou need to stop trying to\ndo everything by yourself.

Anne and I can keep
Lymle from moving! That
way you can just aim at
the gun, right?
Yes, that'll work! Thank\nyou! Leave it to me!
Let's go, Anne!
Okay!
Arrrgh!
Whoa!!!
Are you okay, Lymle!?\nYou're not hurt, are you?
Heh, as if one of Faize's\nwimpy spells could hurt\nme.
Lymle! Watch your\ntongue...
He...really did save me,\nthough. Thanks, Faize...
Ah, hehe. It was nothing,\nLymle.
Hey! Faize, what are you\ngrinning about!?
Sorry, it's just nice to see\nyou talking openly for a\nchange.
Bah! I'm always honest,\n'kay! An open book!
Wh-what are you all\nsmiling at me for!?

Ah, it's a beautiful thing,
seeing you get along so
nicely. How nice, to be so
young.

Lymle, you haven't seen
Faize in such a long time.
Why not give him a little
peck on the cheek?
Commander Kenny!

What? No, I just meant in
a friendly way! You're
totally getting the wrong
idea!
I'm going back home!
Wait, Lymle...
She seems really angry\nthis time.
Commander Kenny...
Sorry, sorry...
